objectives.description: Build reduced-scale scratch fixture, run pre-fix and post-fix probe, record build_errors/status
Stage+commit the move, re-run post-fix probe, assert two post-fix readings agree
Confirm reverse direction: genuinely broken file still counted
Run validate-state.sh --deep against state.json with phantom_paths
Confirm sole production caller via grep -rln assess-repo-health agent-system/

approaches_tried.approach: First reduced-scale fixture had ALL structural candidates inside the moved/renamed directory (no untouched companion file)
approaches_tried.reason: Hit Phase 1's all-phantom degenerate branch on the pre-commit reading (build_errors: null, status: unknown) vs the post-commit reading's build_errors: 0/status: healthy -- these legitimately disagree because the degenerate branch's zero-candidate state isn't representative of a real repo, which always has other untouched structural files. Rebuilt the fixture with a companion untouched valid *.sh so total_candidates stays nonzero in both readings, producing a meaningful agree/disagree comparison.

pre_fix_probe_precommit.note: no phantom_paths field existed pre-fix; 3 phantom index entries scored as real defects -- total inflation, matching the reported production shape

reduced_scale_fixture.acceptance_check: post-fix pre-commit and post-fix post-commit readings AGREE on build_errors (0) and status (healthy)

reverse_direction_check.note: a genuinely broken file plus an unrelated phantom entry -- broken file counted exactly once, phantom entry excluded

evidence.validate_state_deep: exit 0, 0 failures, phantom_paths field accepted (WARN-only findings unrelated to the schema addition, from the synthetic fixture lacking a git worktree and sibling TODO.md)
evidence.sole_caller_confirmation: grep -rln assess-repo-health agent-system/ returns: commands/todo.md (the only caller), manifest.json (file-copy registration, not a caller), assess-repo-health.sh itself, its test suite, and utility-scripts-inventory.md (self-reference/docs) -- confirms commands/todo.md is the sole production call site
evidence.defect_c_note: Step 5A's --argjson MAX_ARG_STRLEN argument-length defect was verified closed upstream by the research pass (specs/020_fix_todo_metrics_sync_precommit_phantom_paths/reports/01_metrics-sync-phantom-paths.md) against the state-write.sh transparent-spill fix and its regression suites; deliberately untouched by this plan (see Non-Goals)
evidence.claude_boundary_check: git status --short .claude/ returns empty (gitignored, untracked); git status --short outside agent-system/extensions/core/ and specs/ shows only pre-existing unrelated modifications present before this task began
